subject.title: fix(cron): support current and session: targets in initial delivery resolution

question: Should typed and declaration-keyed current or named-session output jobs persist explicit announce delivery, matching their established effective runtime behavior?
rationale: The implementation is correct, but it changes serialized job representation from omitted delivery to explicit announce, and repository policy treats persisted default changes as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Accept aligned persistence
options.body: Merge the focused fix and make explicit announce the canonical stored form for these output targets.

options.title: Preserve omitted representation
options.body: Keep delivery absent for these callers if omission versus explicit announce is an intentional serialized contract.

recommendation.title: Accept aligned persistence
recommendation.body: Merge the focused fix and make explicit announce the canonical stored form for these output targets.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the centralized helper and authored the persistent-session contract the patch aligns.
